title: Ok BUT….
review: This app is OK, but due to ads, it gets interrupted when you need to use it at times. Additionally, most phone speakers are set for human use and top out below 20 kHz. So setting it at 20 to 25 kHz will not illicit a strong sound if any at all for your pet. Keeping it below 20kHz should let your phone push out the signal intended, as long as the volume is up. Most training transmitters recommend 15 to 30kHz for dogs.
